title: Minimal Basal Medium Preparation
author: Christa Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b58kq9uw
materials: Cool autoclaved solutions to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Sea Salt Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a sea salt solution in a 1 L glass bottle.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 g Sigma Sea Salts to the bottle.
Add 699 mL dH2O and mix well to dissolve (use a stir bar if needed).
Set solution aside until ready to autoclave.

steps.title: Prepare FeEDTA Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare and sterilize a 1.36 mM FeEDTA stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 mg FeEDTA into a 250 mL glass bottle.
Add 100 mL dH2O and mix well to dissolve.
Filter-sterilize the solution using a 0.2 micron PES membrane filter.

steps.title: Prepare Basal Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare a basal medium solution in a 1 L glass bottle.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 mL of 1 M Tris HCl (pH 7.5) to the bottle.
Add 0.34 g NH4Cl and dissolve.
Add 182.98 mg K2HPO4 and dissolve.
Add 375 mL dH2O and mix well.
Set solution aside until ready to autoclave.

steps.title: Autoclave Solutions
steps.instruction: Sterilize the sea salt solution and basal medium.

substeps.instruction: Loosen lids before autoclaving.
Autoclave the sea salt solution and basal medium separately (do not combine before autoclaving).
Tighten lids after autoclaving.

steps.title: Assemble Minimal Basal Medium
steps.instruction: Combine the sterilized components into the sea salt solution bottle.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 mL of FeEDTA stock to the bottle of sea salt solution and mix well.
Add 250 mL basal medium to the bottle of sea salt solution and mix well.
Add 1 mL of vitamin supplement (MBM Vitamin Supplement by Christa Smith) to the bottle and mix well.

steps.title: Store and Finalize Medium
steps.instruction: Store the prepared medium and add carbon source if required.

substeps.instruction: Store prepared medium at 4 Celsius.
Filter the medium through a 0.2 micron PES membrane if needed.
If adding a carbon source, use a filter-sterilized (0.2 micron PES membrane) stock solution stored frozen, adding the type and concentration as needed.
